## PRODUCT DESCRIPTION

Test Serif is an elegant modern serif typeface designed for luxury branding and editorial projects with refined letterforms and beautiful ligatures.

This typeface features high-contrast strokes, delicate curves, and stylish alternates that bring a timeless yet contemporary aesthetic to your creative work. Perfect for fashion campaigns, magazine headlines, wedding invitations, and premium packaging.

**Features:**

- Uppercase and lowercase
- Numerals and punctuation
- Alternates and ligatures
- OTF, TTF, WOFF, WOFF2 included
- Works on PC and Mac
